sentences.text: Squatirhina is a member of the class Chondrichthyes, which includes cartilaginous fish like sharks and rays, and belongs to the order Rajiformes. Its family placement remains listed as incertae sedis, meaning it is currently unknown.
The genus Squatirhina was described by Casier in 1947.
There are 69 recorded fossil occurrences of Squatirhina in the Paleobiology Database.
This animal lived during the Late Cretaceous period, with a time range spanning from the Barremian to the Maastrichtian, between 125.77 and 66 million years ago.
Fossils of Squatirhina have been found in the Aguja and Pen Formations of Big Bend National Park in Texas, USA.
